preregistered_note: This contract was written and committed BEFORE session 1 launched. Thresholds are frozen from ce6cb81's measured-noise analysis (results/ab_noise.json: baseline MAD 0.905 s, SD 0.926 s); they must not be rewritten after seeing any result. Formal ACCEPT_PERFORMANCE remains governed by the campaign's existing acceptance policy and is NOT granted by this contract.

canonical_baseline.equivalence_note: The newest canonical kernel (dee-cpp-dsv4-217-compact-20260904, ran 2026-09-05) embeds a different bundle (547a236d...) that carries the SAME commit 217a3335 (verified by git bundle list-heads; same commit hash = same tree = same engine source by content addressing). This experiment uses the seal-era bundle (ac2bac46...), which also carries 217a3335. Both arms share one harness; only the cap constant differs.
canonical_baseline.checkpoint_dataset: nivind/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-shards (mounted read-only; download disallowed by harness preflight)
canonical_baseline.correctness_gates: harness classify_full_generation: 16/16 exact token IDs + exact decoded text + integrity + storage; ACCEPT_CORRECTNESS required

A.label: baseline cap 17.0 GiB total (8.5 GiB/GPU, 682 records/GPU)

B.label: candidate cap 20.0 GiB total (10.0 GiB/GPU, 803 records/GPU)
B.harness: base harness with EXACTLY ONE change: LRU_TOTAL_CAP_GIB 17.0 -> 20.0 (verified single occurrence, diff recorded by make_harness.py)

identical_across_arms: engine source (same embedded bundle, same commit)
no prefetch, no Muse optimizations, no approximate codecs, no KT
kernel hardware (2x Tesla T4), image, dataset mounts
trace bank bytes (one bank built/validated in-session, reused deterministically)
matched.forbidden_env: no NATIVE_* env vars may be set at arm runtime (harness preflight fails closed on them); all config flows through harness constants

sessions.design: two matched pairs, two notebook/kernel sessions, counterbalanced arm order, fixed BEFORE session 1
sessions.pread_rider: ONLY after all four arms are terminal; never before or between arms; depths 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16

decision_rule.correctness: every VALID arm must be ACCEPT_CORRECTNESS; any gate failure invalidates that arm's pair; if any arm fails correctness the experiment is INVALID_EXPERIMENT unless the failure is clearly environmental (disk/hardware), which also invalidates the pair

memory.contract: 32-GB-class envelope per ce6cb81 MEMORY_UNIT_CONTRACT; projection for arm B: 27.227 GiB total = 29.23 decimal GB, projected min MemAvailable 4.12 GiB
memory.on_abort: classify PACK_CAP_MEMORY_REJECTED (candidate side) or INVALID_EXPERIMENT (baseline side)

performance.primary_unit: matched full decode run (per-token latencies are dependent samples, NOT replicates)
performance.meaningful_noise_source: baseline MAD of 3 same-config seal-era baselines (ce6cb81 results/ab_noise.json); frozen

order_effect.test: session 1 runs A->B; session 2 runs B->A
order_effect.order_confounded_if: exactly one pair improves AND that improving arm is the one that ran SECOND in its session

causal_cases.CASE_1_replay_failed: candidate storage misses do NOT fall (misses_B >= misses_A - 10): the pack replay/model failed
causal_cases.CASE_2_service_model_failed: storage misses fall by >= 30 but the wall deltas do not reach informative-positive and no order confound: the service-per-miss / critical-path model failed
causal_cases.CASE_3_supported: misses fall as predicted AND both pairs improve beyond noise: hypothesis supported

prediction_NOT_results.simulated_note: SIMULATED (recalibrated observational model, 48.679 ms/miss, ce6cb81). These are hypotheses. The measured miss delta and wall deltas from this experiment are the actual results.

provenance_per_run: checkpoint identity (shard header sha256s from preflight)
